title: Kidnapper Gets Busted By Police
description:
In the town of Lisbon, WI, Trooper Edwards observed a vehicle matching the description of the suspect. Upon approach, he also observed a female in the rear passenger seat who matched the description in the advisory. The Minnesota man was arrested by law enforcement for kidnapping and false imprisonment.
